name: csv-data
title: Data Studio (CSV)
description: A per-chat CSV analysis studio via /csv slash commands: load datasets by pasting CSV text right after the command (RFC 4180 parsing — quoted fields, embedded commas/newlines/escaped quotes, automatic , ; or tab delimiter detection), or start from /csv sample. Explore with head/stats/top/sort/filter (numeric-aware comparisons), aggregate with sum/avg/min/max/count, and visualize a column as an in-chat ASCII bar chart or histogram (/csv chart). Datasets live in per-chat storage (up to ~56 KB each) — another chat starts empty. No network needed.
